先把“想看红木”“想看荒野海岸”“想吃午饭后看海”分开。编辑建议：三处只选一个作: Separate a redwood walk, a remote coastline visit and lunch with a beach stroll. Editor advice: choose one main destination for the day, even with a rental car. A navigation estimate omits car collection, queues, walking, meals, refueling and traffic on the return.
无车、能提前订好往返：优先检查 Muir Woods 指定日接驳；若不合适，改成: Without a car and able to reserve both ways: check the dated Muir Woods shuttle first. If it does not work, choose a city park or the existing Sausalito waterfront half-day guide.
有车、想看开阔海岸：Point Reyes 适合独立一天；把 Bear Vall: With a car and a wish for open coastline: give Point Reyes its own day. An editorial limit is Bear Valley plus one confirmed-open destination.
住半岛、偏轻松吃饭散步：Half Moon Bay 可先比较 294 路与自驾；: Based on the Peninsula and wanting food and an easy stroll: compare route 294 with driving to Half Moon Bay, including the final stretch to the beach.
出发前一天：先填交通空格: The day before: fill in the transport details
向每位同行者确认能走多久、是否需要轮椅或推车，以及当天必须回到住处的时间。编辑建: Ask everyone about walking tolerance, wheelchairs or strollers, and the time they must be back. Work backward from an acceptable return before dark or dinner. A city outing is usually easier to control on a flight day.
保存完整目的地名称、预约日期、人数、票种、接驳集合点和订单号；不要只存“红木公园: Save the complete destination, date, party size, ticket type, shuttle meeting point and confirmation number, not just a generic map pin.
公交方案同时保存去程、返程和较早的备用班次；核对周六、周日与工作日，不能凭上一班: Save outbound, return and an earlier backup departure; distinguish Saturday, Sunday and weekday schedules rather than extrapolating frequency.
开车准备驾照、租车取车要求及停车付款方式；把加油、充电和收费道路单列，实际价格由: Drivers should prepare their licence, rental collection requirements and parking payment method. Budget separately for fuel, charging and tolls using operator or checkout prices.
Muir Woods：入园与抵达是两张账: Muir Woods: admission and getting there are separate costs
NPS 当前列普通入园费为每名 16 岁及以上游客 $15，未满 16 岁免入园: NPS currently lists standard admission at $15 per visitor aged 16 or over; under-16s enter free. Parking or shuttle reservations cost extra. Check the coverage and photo-ID requirements of any eligible park pass; it does not reserve parking or a shuttle seat.
授权预约网站的详细运营段写明：十月接驳在周六、周日运行，地点为 Larkspur: The authorized booking site’s detailed operating section specifies Saturdays and Sundays in October from Larkspur Ferry Terminal: $4 adult round trip, free for ages 15 and under, with reservations for both directions. Its broader Friday–Sunday introduction does not confirm October Friday service; check the dated booking calendar.
先查接驳日期与往返预约: Check dated shuttle service and both reservations
使用官方预约入口选择日期、人数与往返安排；有轮椅或行动辅助器具时，按网站要求提前: Use the official reservation entry to choose the date, party and both directions. Book the ADA shuttle in advance when required for a wheelchair or mobility device. Do not treat a seat as secured until confirmed.
船、接驳、停车分别确认: Confirm ferry, shuttle and parking separately
从 SF 坐船到 Larkspur 不等于已订红木林接驳。官网要求提前 15 分: A ferry trip from SF to Larkspur is not a shuttle booking. The shuttle page asks riders to arrive 15 minutes early. Allow separately for ferry tickets, walking and waiting, and check terminal parking if driving there. The shuttle fare is not the day’s total.
把确认单、地图和返程信息离线保存。NPS 说明林区没有手机信号，游客中心 Wi-: Save confirmations, maps and return details offline. NPS reports no cellular service and limited visitor-center Wi-Fi; plan as though the whole visit is offline. Do not rely solely on booking a rideshare after the walk, and agree on a precise meeting place before separating.
先换日期或查看另一种抵达方式，不占无预约停车位。NPS 所列 61 路方案要下山: Try another date or arrival method rather than using unreserved parking. The route 61 option described by NPS entails about 1.3 miles downhill and an uphill return; it is not a practical last-minute fallback for wheelchair, stroller or low-stamina visitors. Consider a shorter city outing.
Point Reyes：公交到达不代表能逛完整座公园: Point Reyes: reaching the area is not a tour of the whole park
普通入园、游客中心及步道口停车和一般日间活动不收 NPS 费用，露营、特别活动等: NPS charges no admission, ordinary visitor-center or trailhead parking, or standard day-use fees. Camping and special uses are separate. Free entry still leaves transport, fuel, food and return costs to budget.
NPS 的区内交通说明显示，West Marin Stagecoach 可从 S: NPS describes West Marin Stagecoach access from San Rafael to the Bear Valley area, but no service farther west than Inverness and no public transport touring the park’s destinations. If you want the lighthouse, Tomales Point or remote beaches without a car, arrange the full journey before setting out.
NPS 提醒园内没有加油或汽车服务站。编辑建议离开城镇前补足燃料或电量、带饮水与: NPS says there are no fuel or vehicle service stations within the seashore. Refuel or charge before leaving town and bring water and lunch. EV drivers should verify usable charging rather than treating a map marker as live availability.
出发前看 Point Reyes 道路与步道状况: Check Point Reyes roads and trails before leaving
先打开当期警报，再选实际目的地；网页空白或动态内容没有显示时，不把它理解为全园无: Open current alerts before choosing the actual destination. Blank or unloaded dynamic content does not mean there are no closures. Ask the visitor center about the intended area when needed.
Half Moon Bay：查清到的是市区还是海滩入口: Half Moon Bay: distinguish town from the beach entrance
SamTrans 294 路官方页面列 Hillsdale–Half Moon: The official SamTrans route 294 page lists Hillsdale–Half Moon Bay with separate eastbound, westbound, weekday, Saturday and Sunday schedules. Plan access from your accommodation and the final distance to 95 Kelly Avenue. Do not treat the Hillsdale shopping area and Caltrain station as the same place.
Half Moon Bay State Beach 当前列车辆日间使用费 $10: Half Moon Bay State Beach currently lists a $10 vehicle day-use fee, subject to seasonal, holiday or weekend variation, and hours of 8am to sunset. Francis Beach at 95 Kelly Avenue has listed restrooms and picnic facilities. Day use and campsite reservations are separate; follow posted entrance charges.
想轻松看海，停留在容易折返的范围: Keep a beach visit easy to shorten
州立公园提醒海水冷且有离岸流。编辑建议把这一站安排成岸上散步，风浪大就缩短；需要: State Parks warns of cold water and rip currents. Treat this as a shore walk and shorten it when conditions worsen. Ask Francis Beach’s entrance station about the free beach wheelchair beforehand; availability is not guaranteed.
选择实际出游日类型，保存海岸返程站和目标班次；若衔接太少，改自驾、提前确认的往返: Select the actual day type and save the coast-side return stop and departure. If connections are too limited, choose driving, confirmed round-trip transport or a city outing.
红木林日：预约抵达 → 林内短走 → 按已订回程离开；可选延伸只放在回到交通枢纽: Redwoods day: reserved arrival → short forest walk → booked return. Add anything extra only after reaching the transport hub.
Point Reyes 日：Bear Valley 确认状况 → 一个可达目标: Point Reyes day: check conditions at Bear Valley → one reachable destination → return. If the remote stop is closed, keep the nearer visit.
半月湾日：先解决午餐 → Francis Beach 短走 → 提前回到返程点；: Half Moon Bay day: lunch → short Francis Beach walk → return stop early. Bus waits should not consume the buffer for a flight or fixed dinner reservation.
带当天需要的票、通票与证件、离线地图、充电宝、防风层、饮水和垃圾袋；贵重物品随身: Bring tickets, passes and required ID, offline maps, a power bank, windproof layers, water and a rubbish bag; keep valuables with you.
同行者共享集合点、必须开始返程的时间、联系不上时的等候位置和交通预算上限。: Share the meeting point, latest return start, waiting place if contact fails and transport budget limit.
出发前再查预约确认邮件、运营商班表、目标路段与天气；任一关键回程环节没有落实就缩: Recheck confirmation emails, operator schedules, the intended route and weather. Shorten the outing if any essential return leg is unresolved.

The official unit prices here are not all-in trip costs or proof of availability. Compare a shared rental against the full transit journey and everyone’s stamina.
